title: Waqrapukara Full-Day Tour
short_description: Discover Waqrapukara, the striking horn-shaped Inca fortress above the Apurímac Canyon, on a full-day adventure from Cusco.
long_description: Discover Waqrapukara, one of Cusco's most surprising archaeological sites. The “horned fortress” rises above the Apurímac Canyon. After crossing Andean communities, hike to the sanctuary at over 4,100 meters. Ideal for trekking, archaeology and nature lovers.
price_note: Price per person for group service. Ask about rates and availability.

days.title: Day 1: Cusco – Waqrapukara – Cusco
days.text: Depart early from Cusco toward the south and stop for breakfast. Hike through mountain scenery to Waqrapukara, the horned fortress above Apurímac Canyon. Your guide explains its history and architecture, followed by time to explore and photograph the site. Descend, enjoy lunch and return to Cusco.
